entry.title: /g/ Technology: Capability-based security
entry.content: How come operating systems with capability-based security didn't take off for general-purpose computing? Google tried it with Fuchsia OS and its Zircon microkernel, but they winded down the project for some reason, even cancelling the Chrome port. An ideal desktop OS would use a microkernel heavily inspired by seL4, would use capability-based security and probably would implement a POSIX personality on top that is fully compliant with POSIX.1-2017 and the Single UNIX Specification, version 4, 20
entry.dc:creator: /g/ Technology
